findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; recorded affinities are removed and the label prior is equal, so no observed affinity outcome is available to either role.

Continuous contrast features over the complete observed window are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z positive and last_rate_z negative, and landmark_00_local_dx shows 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts, so a constant rule is not supported and a time-conditioned rule is indicated.

Polynomial fits are not accepted for these continuous features and extrapolation is disallowed, so only observed-node interpolation within the observed support is admissible; the contrast curves are coordinate contrasts, not absolute reward targets.

Joint diagnostics show a coherent positive within-selector association for teacher_contrast_coherence (whole-window mean about 0.81, all batches positive) and for innovation_native_alignment (null-tested, q about 2.2e-9, all batches positive), indicating coupled rather than isolated marginal structure.

The observed_child_score_gain joint diagnostic is negative (whole-window mean about -0.036, positive_batch_fraction 0.0, q about 1.8e-7), so immediate selection evidence disagrees in sign with descendant score credit; this is a within-selector descriptive association, not a causal selection effect.

Several joint diagnostics (innovation_RMS_A, teacher_contrast_RMS_A, teacher_contrast_coherence, teacher_control_root_ESS) are not null-tested and carry no q value, so they cannot be ranked by multiplicity-adjusted support and remain descriptive.

hypotheses.falsifier: no improvement in observed-node fit fidelity or a sign pattern inconsistent with the observed nodes
hypotheses.observable: sign and rate of the landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dx contrast features at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule that follows the observed-node sign structure of landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dx will track the observed contrast better than a constant rule over the observed window.

hypotheses.falsifier: joint coherence association disappears under batch-level resampling or is fully explained by a single marginal
hypotheses.scope: within-selector descriptive association, batch as independent unit
hypotheses.statement: Coherent joint teacher-contrast structure carries information beyond isolated marginal descriptors, so a joint-pattern reward recipe is preferable to a single marginal coordinate term.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied; last-record or descendant score credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
The observed_child_score_gain disagreement is a within-selector descriptive association and is not evidence of a causal selection effect or atom velocity.
Continuous contrast features are coordinate contrasts in predicted endpoint world coordinates, not physical interaction energies or neural-module causation.
Polynomial fits are rejected and extrapolation is disallowed, so no claim beyond the observed support is made.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and were not proposed or edited.
